## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Technology, Materials and Healthcare are showing leadership (AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +49.72%), NUE ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.01% | 1M: +33.85%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +31.16%)) and sector breadth sits at the threshold for rotation; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology lead: ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +21.91%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +49.72%) — Tech breadth: 17/24 positive. Materials strong: NUE ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.01% | 1M: +33.85%) — Materials breadth: 8/11 positive. Healthcare leadership via UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +31.16%) — Healthcare breadth: 6/17 positive.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Industrials lagging: LMT BELOW TREND (1W: -9.11% | 1M: -9.87%), RTX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -7.14%) — Industrials breadth: 5/15 positive. Healthcare has mixed pockets but overall softness beyond UNH: JNJ BELOW TREND (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -3.96%) — Healthcare breadth: 6/17 positive. Utilities weak: Utilities breadth: 2/10 positive with no large leaders.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +49.72%), NUE ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.01% | 1M: +33.85%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +31.16%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +21.91%), PANW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.41% | 1M: +10.45%). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -13.43% | 1M: -0.15%), GE BELOW TREND (1W: -11.99% | 1M: -5.23%), LMT BELOW TREND (1W: -9.11% | 1M: -9.87%), ABT BELOW TREND (1W: -9.71% | 1M: -11.99%), RTX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -7.14%). Weakness concentrated in Industrials and select Communication names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strong 1W movers: AMD (1W: +17.57%), NUE (1W: +13.01%), UNH (1W: +12.57%), ORCL (1W: +10.42%), PANW (1W: +10.41%). Major divergence present (NOW RECOVERY (1W: +9.43% | 1M: -7.10%), PLTR RECOVERY (1W: +7.37% | 1M: -5.11%), TSLA CORRECTION (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +1.75%)) — treat as tactical momentum, not core confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed but leading on internals; AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.53% | 1M: +8.62%), MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.28% | 1M: +13.03%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +15.29%), NOW RECOVERY (1W: +9.43% | 1M: -7.10%) — Tech breadth: 17/24 positive, but dispersion is high.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are soft 1W but constructive 1M; JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +8.52%) while SCHW BELOW TREND (1W: -8.54% | 1M: -3.77%) — Financials breadth: 7/20 positive; mixed signals keep sector in rotation, not clear leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare shows pockets of strength around UNH but breadth is weak; UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +31.16%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +1.20%), JNJ BELOW TREND (1W: -5.27% | 1M: -3.96%) — Healthcare breadth: 6/17 positive; watch idiosyncratic earnings/news.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals and select tech winners (NUE, AMD, ORCL) and maintain exposure to UNH while reducing exposure to lagging Industrials/weak Communication names (LMT, RTX, NFLX). Style: Mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and divergence; monitor momentum names for mean-reversion risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.26% | 1M: +25.28%) — news-confirmed strength; UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +31.16%) — momentum confirmed; AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +49.72%) — trend intact. BEARISH: NOW RECOVERY (1W: +9.43% | 1M: -7.10%) — conflicting headlines (-60 vs +50) and watch for follow-through; NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -13.43% | 1M: -0.15%) — downside momentum.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (NUE driving returns) — Materials breadth: 8/11 positive. Technology (leadership, but concentrated) — Tech breadth: 17/24 positive. BEARISH: Industrials (LMT/RTX weakness) — Industrials breadth: 5/15 positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA break above near-term pivot would confirm further upside — watch for continuation above recent swing high; AAPL support area around interim pullback (~recent 1M base) to test buyers; UNH breakout continuation above recent highs would confirm healthcare rotation; JPM reclaiming monthly pivot would reinforce financial resilience.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
TXN (+60): Texas Instruments — TXN ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.26% | 1M: +25.28%) — price confirms bullish headline. UNH (+55): UnitedHealth — UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +31.16%) — news and price confirming accumulation. GE (+60): GE BELOW TREND (1W: -11.99% | 1M: -5.23%) — bullish headlines but price is diverging (distribution) — monitor for mean reversion.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NOW (-60): ServiceNow — NOW RECOVERY (1W: +9.43% | 1M: -7.10%) — conflicting headlines (+50 and -60) and price bounce suggests headline-driven volatility; limited strong bearish-news overlap across SP100 in the last 5 days beyond NOW, so monitor other names flagged by media for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, style mixed / no clear leadership as tech and materials lead but leadership is narrow. AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.57% | 1M: +49.72%), NUE ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.01% | 1M: +33.85%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.57% | 1M: +31.16%) are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large names (NOW, PLTR, TSLA) and mixed news sentiment (GE, NOW) — monitor for trend confirmation before enlarging core positions.
